changes: Raw token recognizes 萬, strict parsing copy folds 萬 to 万; original raw token and CP span unchanged.
萬/億/兩 are recognized by numeric boundary/arithmetic guards, without adding exact 兩/億 parsing.
Explicit arithmetic can bind a 2-16 Han-character coefficient/ratio name ending in 系数/系數/比例, including OCR breaks and Cf detection copies.
Existing finite operands, symbolic identifiers, rate/date exceptions and explicit multiplier/fraction routes retained.
Single-character generic arithmetic avoids ordinary 加班/加薪、减免/减薪、除外/除了 words even across layout breaks.
Candidate anchored currency call forwards candidate.subject to the coordinated optional-argument API.
limitations: Synthetic parser/runtime/source/historical checks, not real model inference or HTTP acceptance.
Names outside the finite coefficient-suffix grammar and longer than 16 Han characters are not claimed as covered. No arithmetic is evaluated.
Exact support newly aliases 萬 only. 億/兩 remain unsupported as money syntax; numeric guards prevent extracting a supported tail.
Historical null/unsupported amounts remain null, with no automatic upgrade.
Fixed-baseline native checks use its old two-argument currency implementation; JavaScript ignores the new third argument. Integration type checking requires DATA final optional-subject API.
The small currency API probe used a read-only DATA WIP overlay; it is not a final independent review or full currency acceptance.
